markdown.markdown: ::: {.page-band} ::: {.band-inner} ::: {.band-eyebrow} Reading, tools, and data ::: ::: ::: ::: {.prose} A working list, maintained by members. If something here is out of date or you think a resource belongs on it, mention it at a session. ::: ::: {.resource-group} ::: {.eyebrow} Starting points ::: ## Where to begin - [Bit by Bit — Matthew Salganik](https://www.bitbybitbook.com/) — the standard introduction to social research in the digital age, free to read online. - [Summer Institutes in Computational Social Science](https://sicss.io/) — materials and recorded lectures from SICSS, openly available. - [Text as Data — Grimmer, Roberts & Stewart](https://press.princeton.edu/books/paperback/9780691207551/text-as-data) — the reference for text-as-data methods in the social sciences. ::: ::: {.resource-group} ::: {.eyebrow} Methods ::: ## Methods and tutorials - [statnet](https://statnet.org/) — R packages for network analysis and ERGMs, with tutorials. - [NetLogo](https://ccl.northwestern.edu/netlogo/) — agent-based modeling environment; the models library alone is worth reading. - [The Effect — Nick Huntington-Klein](https://theeffectbook.net/) — causal inference, free online. - [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/) — pretrained models, including Turkish-language ones such as BERTurk. ::: ::: {.resource-group} ::: {.eyebrow} Data ::: ## Data sources - [V-Dem](https://v-dem.net/) — comparative measures of democracy, 1789 to present. - [Correlates of War](https://correlatesofwar.org/) — interstate conflict, alliances, trade, and national capabilities. - [TÜİK](https://www.tuik.gov.tr/) — Turkish Statistical Institute; national statistics and microdata. - [İBB Açık Veri Portalı](https://data.ibb.gov.tr/) — Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data. ::: ::: {.resource-group} ::: {.eyebrow} At Boğaziçi ::: ## Around the university - [Department of Political Science and International Relations](https://polsci.bogazici.edu.tr/) - [Boğaziçi University Library](https://library.bogazici.edu.tr/) — database access, including subscription journals and statistical software licences. :::
